D4_selection: among source/safety/process-complete D2/D3 choose lowest worst-arm peak TCP translation (ties D2); if none skip D4; repeat selected even if performance fails to report reproducibility
computed_torque: not permitted absent independent applicable current-state model qualification

controller.baseline: R7 S3 PD gains; S1 is damping-only
controller.initial_state: 180 native-drive observed steps; q within .005rad of official start; source-valid then capture actual q0/dq0; no teleport
controller.mass: freeze symmetric same-state arm block M0 at ownership, not update during run
controller.smooth_reference: q0+dq0*T*(s-6s^3+8s^4-3s^5), T=.15s, 0<=s<=1, then q0; analytic dq_ref

formal_prerequisite: selected diagnostic and D4 both all-sample acceptance PASS with same strategy and initial policy; freeze exact controller rule; one fresh 60-step run, no retune
moving: only after formal PASS; separately freeze C2 small collision-checked reference before execution
threshold_distinction: 1mm is performance, not step abort; 0.100mm original G1 grasp closure unchanged and not applied to free-home hold
